default.title: Total production Units for Self-Consumption - Monthly
default.description:
This dataset presents the number of certified Self-Consumption Production Units (UPACs) connected to the E-REDES-operated grid and holding an active contract on the last day of the month under analysis.

The data are organized by geographical location (district, municipality, parish, and postal code), installed capacity range, total installed capacity, voltage level, and technology type.

UPACs are electricity generation installations intended for self-consumption. The energy produced may be consumed locally and, where applicable, surplus energy may be injected into the grid.

The dataset enables monitoring of the evolution and geographical distribution of self-consumption units connected to the grid, identifying installation and capacity concentration patterns, and supporting analyses related to renewable energy integration, energy communities, and electricity network planning.


Use cases:

  • Assess the distribution of UPACs by district, municipality, parish, and postal code.
  • Monitor the monthly evolution of the number of self-consumption installations connected to the grid.
  • Analyze installed capacity by capacity range, voltage level, and technology type.
  • Identify areas with a higher concentration of distributed generation.
  • Support studies related to electricity network planning, expansion, and reinforcement.


Update frequency: Monthly


Included variables:

  • Date — Reference date of the information.
  • Year — Year corresponding to the analysis period.
  • Month — Month corresponding to the analysis period.
  • Postal Code — Postal code associated with the location of the generation installation.
  • District — Name of the district where the generation installation is located.
  • Municipality — Name of the municipality where the generation installation is located.
  • Parish — Name of the parish where the generation installation is located.
  • Installed Capacity Range — Installed capacity interval in which the UPAC is classified.
  • Number of Installations — Number of certified UPACs connected to the grid and holding an active contract.
  • Total Installed Capacity (kW) — Sum of the installed capacities of the UPACs, representing the maximum generation capacity of the installations.
  • Voltage Level — Voltage level at the installation’s point of connection to the grid, such as Low Voltage or Medium Voltage.
  • Technology Type — Generation technology used by the UPAC, such as solar photovoltaic.


1. The information provided by E-REDES is an approximation of the values obtained from the system and is based on the time at which it was collected. Given that connection points, the electricity distribution network, and the consumption and production values themselves are naturally very dynamic, please note that the information provided may be subject to subsequent changes and updates.
